responsibility: Utility script that regenerates per-.opt documentation mapping files by combining generated HTML option indexes with GCC’s source-tree .opt option-definition files. It parses language-independent and frontend-specific option index pages, canonicalizes positive/negative spellings and duplicate anchors, filters target-specific manual pages so options are only matched to the correct backend subdirectory, reads .opt records, and writes FOO.opt.urls files containing UrlSuffix or LangUrlSuffix directives. Its output is the source-side table data that associates GCC option definitions with their manual URL anchors across generic, target, and language-specific options.
